env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

logos build -o $WORK/bin/scroll$GOEXE ./scroll
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'
exists $WORK/bin/scroll$GOEXE

logos run ./scroll
stdout '^scroll ok$'
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

logos build -o $WORK/bin/lightning$GOEXE ./lightning
stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

stderr -count=1 'portability::alias_extension'

stderr -count=4 'portability::alias_extension'

-- binary/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type Inner struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

func rejects(name, field string, err error) {
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), field) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "offset 1") {
		fmt.Printf("FAIL binary %s: %v\n", name, err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("binary " + name + " ok")
}

func main() {
	s := ScrollHolder{P: &Inner{}}
	rejects("scroll", "ScrollHolder.P", s.UnmarshalBinary([]byte{1, 0}))
	l := LightningHolder{P: &Inner{}}
	rejects("lightning", "LightningHolder.P", l.UnmarshalBinary([]byte{1, 0}))
	g := GopherHolder{P: &Inner{}}
	rejects("gopher", "GopherHolder.P", g.UnmarshalBinary([]byte{1, 0}))
	v := VSHolder{P: &Inner{}}
	rejects("vs", "VSHolder.P", v.UnmarshalBinary([]byte{1, 0}))
}

-- binary/scroll.📜 --
package main

type ScrollHolder struct {
	P *Inner `json:"p"`
}

-- binary/lightning.⚡ --
package main

type LightningHolder struct {
	P *Inner `json:"p"`
}

-- binary/gopher.ʕ◔ϖ◔ʔ --
package main

type GopherHolder struct {
	P *Inner `json:"p"`
}

-- binary/vs.⚡️ --
package main

type VSHolder struct {
	P *Inner `json:"p"`
}
